annotations.text:
Direction: Sarvam-style gradient as atmosphere, Vyra-style tactility as objects.

The gradient is the ground plane on marketing and entry surfaces. Everything you press is a solid raised object sitting on top of it — hairline border, inset top highlight, a 2px bottom edge, and a real 2px drop on press.

The one hard rule: the gradient stops at the board edge.

Inside a live class the field appears only as a 3px line under the header and as the room-code card in the rail. The canvas stays warm paper at full contrast — it has to survive a projector and 45 minutes of reading.
